scope: Re-read only the corrected final evidence-commit and push block; retain the preceding complete-template read-only review.

finding.description: The previous template bound source/evidence preservation to the source commit but did not validate the final evidence commit before pushing mutable HEAD.
verified_final_guards: Final evidence commit parent is the verified source commit.
Final committed changed-path set equals the exact payload evidence paths plus SOURCE_PUBLICATION.json and .gitattributes.
Committed evidence, two source files, fourteen retained property files, and unchanged control inputs are rehashed at the final immutable SHA.
Committed publication receipt and attributes match their exact expected bytes.
Protected .github, Tools, project, resources, and Modules trees match the fixed parent; final Anytype/Sources matches the verified source commit.
The remote parent and clean worktree are checked before a normal push of the verified immutable head SHA; actual remote readback must equal it.
